item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Criminal Law Protection of the Agri-Food Sector and EU Constraints (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-14 Diritto penale

The research programme develops a systematic framework on the criminal-law protection of the agri-food sector in light of EU constraints, integrating economic criminal law, environmental criminal law, EU food law and corporate liability. The activity comprises four phases: mapping European and national legal sources; analysis of CJEU, ECtHR and domestic case law on ne bis in idem and proportionality, including research stays at European centres; case studies on food fraud, agricultural environmental offences and fraud against CAP and PNRR funds; drafting of a monograph, scientific essays, a policy paper and operational guidelines on organisational models under Legislative Decree 231/2001…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Digital healthcare, integrated governance models, and criminal-law protection of legal interests: balancing the protection of fundamental rights, data security, and responsible innovation (Univ. CATANIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. CATANIA, Catania
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-14 Diritto penale

This research aims to develop an advanced model of integrated legal and technological governance for innovation in the life sciences, with a particular focus on the use of artificial intelligence in medicine. Through the analysis of AI-based medical devices, telemedicine platforms, clinical decision-support systems, and robotic surgical technologies, the project seeks to identify regulatory and organizational tools capable of ensuring the protection of fundamental rights, patient safety, and health data security. The research will address issues of criminal liability, cybersecurity threats, and technological risk management, leading to the development of policies and operational protocols…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Enhancing criminal mediation for minors involved in hate crimes (MediAction) (Univ. BRESCIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-22 14:00
Institution: Univ. BRESCIA, Brescia
Field: Law / 12/GIUR-12 Diritto processuale civile

The research programme, within the European project MediAction – Enhancing Criminal Mediation for Minors Involved in Hate Crimes (EU Justice Programme), investigates criminal mediation as a restorative justice tool for minors who are victims or perpetrators of hate crimes. Using an interdisciplinary legal, socio-legal and qualitative approach, it will comparatively analyse European and national legislation, policies, guidelines and best practices. Empirical research will include interviews with judges, mediators, lawyers, social workers, victim-support professionals and civil society organisations, as well as focus groups with minors.
